title: Anthem invests in Timbaland's music marketplace Beatclub, acquires additional publishing interests in his catalog (Music Business Worldwide)
notes: MBW, Murray Stassen, 2023-06-07. Anthem invested in Beatclub (Timbaland + Gary Marella beat marketplace, founded 2021) in Series A-2, terms undisclosed; Hipgnosis also invested Feb 2023 (A-2). Beatclub = beat marketplace, NOT the AI-hip-hop company (Stage Zero). Supports Q2 distinction.
